summary: Home material block «Камень изнутри» as a layered 2.5D composition of the six final image_gen fragments: chosen material as hero, its loose piece flying past the card top/right edge, the other material small and behind; matte/gloss switch the matching assets. No procedural fallback in the app.

files.ios/Salini/EssenceLayers.swift: EssenceLayerStage (2.5D stage), EssenceLayer/EssenceLabel manifest, EssenceLayers (manifest, image lookup, availability)
files.ios/Salini/EssenceAssets/*.png: 6 final fragments (image_gen, Codex/user), committed with the component
files.removed: ios/Salini/EssenceScene.swift (procedural SceneKit stage) — no longer shipped

api.select: func select(_ f: StudioFinish, animated: Bool = true)
api.active: var active: Bool — set false at creation; toggle only on visibility change of animationBounds
api.animationBounds: var animationBounds: CGRect — stage incl. 84 pt overflow margin above the card, feature coordinates (.zero if assets missing)
api.illustrated: var illustrated: Bool — stage present (false only if the six PNGs are missing: block becomes copy + chips + studio link)
api.form_for_finish: static func form(for:) — Noemi when it sells the finish, else first form that does; CTA passes (form, finish)

integration_notes: Run xcodegen: EssenceFeature.swift / EssenceLayers.swift / EssenceAssets/*.png are picked up by the existing «Salini» source glob (PNGs land at the bundle root; lookup also checks an «EssenceAssets» subfolder). EssenceScene.swift was deleted — regenerate so the project no longer references it.
Replace MaterialFeatureView(open:) with EssenceFeatureView(open:) on Home.
Keep clipsToBounds false on ancestors up to the column so the fragments may overflow into the stage's own top margin; nothing draws outside the stage bounds by more than a few points.

Lifecycle: display link only while active && in window && app active && Reduce Motion off; resumes on didBecomeActive (not willEnterForeground); repeated setRunning with the same state is a no-op (no lastTick reset).

copy.lead: Однородный S-Stone. Минеральное ядро под тонким слоем Gelcoat — S-Sense.
copy.note: Художественная визуализация состава. Форма и толщина слоёв условны.
copy.removed: bauxite / marble raw-stone mentions; no layer-thickness claim on the image (0,8 мм only in the fact caption)

motion.opening: 0.3 s hold + 2.0 s smootherstep: loose piece parts from its body
motion.focus: critically damped ~0.7 s hero↔back swap; matte/gloss 0.45 s cross-fade of matching assets
motion.float: slow depth-scaled float and sway; scroll parallax ±14 pt × depth
motion.reduce_motion: static opened composition; 0.0 % pixels changed over 3 s

verification.tests: EssenceFeatureTests 7/7 (incl. all six assets ship with alpha, matte/gloss canvases match, manifest round-trip, animationBounds, CTA carries finish, honest accessibility text) on isolated simulator «Salini Essence 18 Pro», tmp/essence-preview copy
verification.typecheck: whole Salini target, iOS 27 simulator SDK

visual.evidence/motion-open-select.mp4, motion-: real-time opening and S-Stone → S-Sense matte → gloss → S-Stone taps

verification.lifecycle: background → Settings → back: animation resumes (10.6 % pixels changed over 1.5 s after return)

limits: Positions and label points are tuned for these six images; new art may need manifest tweaks (EssenceLayers.json override supported).
